conditions: One retained-state historian fixture with a deterministic ten-row tail append.
One affected feature partition containing 173 rows.

included: FULL rolling transforms over every target historian row
Helix rolling transforms over the affected 173-row feature partition

Across both policies, all 240 Helix transitions and all 120 expanded-FULL transitions reconstructed the expected state exactly.
conditions: Three independently seeded deterministic generated 40-transition histories using native Delta Change Data Feed.

Periodic complete snapshots every five or ten transitions were included in the corresponding Helix totals.

included: compressed application-payload bytes delivered over localhost TCP
all periodic snapshot traffic for the N=5 and N=10 policies
excluded: TCP/IP framing and physical network counters
cloud egress, pricing, storage economics, and latency

claims.exact_permitted_statement: In the frozen Experiment 4.1 run-v2 qualification, at approximately 0.1% affected scope, the specific canonical FULL route's governed-validation wall time was 90.385× to 93.327× the experimental Helix route's across 44,224-, 250,000-, and 1,000,000-row deterministic in-memory estates. These are per-cell inverses of arithmetic means from three sequential measured transitions per fresh route worker after one warmup, with retained prepared state. The corresponding predeclared FULL/Helix route-total range was 3.421× to 3.534×. Both routes were exact and validated on all 36 unique measured transition instances; separately, all 333 measured mediated residual-unit instances were exactly localized and repaired in dedicated correctness cells. The experiment remained MIXED and qualification failed because its median sparse Helix/FULL incremental-RSS ratio was 1.5065586419753085 against a 1.50 ceiling; the final campaign was not run.
conditions: Three deterministic in-memory estates: 44,224, 250,000, and 1,000,000 rows.
Published timing cells affected 44, 250, and 1,000 rows respectively, approximately 0.1% of each estate.
One warmup followed by three sequential measured transitions per fresh, non-overlapping route worker.
Retained prepared state on one host.

measurement.metric: specific frozen canonical FULL governed-validation wall time divided by experimental Helix governed-validation wall time
measurement.unit: ratio of per-cell arithmetic-mean perf_counter_ns samples

included: candidate acceptance or promotion and ordinary in-call overhead
excluded: upstream change discovery and transition materialization
process launch, persistence, network, storage, and external integration
unknown: performance against optimized databases or alternate FULL implementations

limitations: The headline ratio is governed-validation wall time, not end-to-end transaction, application, production, or outer-worker latency.
